description.text: This major focuses on cultivating talents with positive outlook on life, values, strong practical work ability, independent development consciousness and innovative consciousness of solving problems. Students are expected to have both global vision and long-term career development goals, master solid micro knowledge structure and professional skills. Students will have an interdisciplinary knowledge structure combining corporate finance, computer and mathematics required in the fields of corporate finance, quantitative finance and financial technology.

duration.text: The Finance at Shanghai University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4166 USD/per year ￥ 30000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Passport photo page2.Passport-sized ID photo3.Selfie video4.An official copy of Highest Degree Certificate (Recent graduates can provide a proof of pre-graduation)5.Official transcripts from previous academic institution6.Language Proficiency Certificate or a screenshot of the scores7.Statement of Financial Support

requirements.text: 1.Non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport2.High school graduation with GPA 3.0/4 or above or its equivalent for Undergraduate Programs3.Qualified mathematics record
